title: The Making of Me
author: Audrey Yeung
description:
Welcome to my 'The Making of Me' Year 9 I&S creative project. In this text adventure, you will learn and experience my personal culture. To move, use cardinal directions like 'north', 'south', 'northwest', 'southeast', etc. To do anything else, use simple commands like 'take', 'inventory', or 'examine'.

You will notice that you gain points throughout gameplay. The more points that you have, the better you will understand and be able to learn about my personal culture.

Experience the room 'Growing Up' last, because that is when the story will end.

Note: The specific people mentioned have allowed me to use their names in this project.
